6.141 rsPageBreakOnChartGroup
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsPageBreakOnChartGroup is a non-critical error that will occur if, for a Chart, any Grouping has the
Grouping.PageBreakAtStart or Grouping.PageBreakAtEnd element set to true, or the
PageBreak.BreakLocation element within the Grouping is not set to "None" or omitted.
